parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is a switch handle of the faucet made of stainless steel, typically cylindrical with a lever for turning water flow on or off.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the water flow and temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or tilts around its axis to adjust water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is another switch handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, used for controlling either hot or cold water.
parts.Functional_description: It regulates one side of the water supply (hot or cold) by turning or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or tilts to control the water flow from one inlet.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is a frame base of the faucet made of stainless steel, providing structural support for the switch handle.
parts.Functional_description: It anchors the switch handle to the sink surface and connects it to the internal valve system.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a stable base for the rotating handle.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is another frame base of the faucet, made of stainless steel, supporting the opposite switch handle.
parts.Functional_description: It secures the handle to the sink and connects to the water inlet system.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet made of stainless steel, curved to direct water flow into the sink.
parts.Functional_description: It delivers the mixed water from the internal plumbing to the sink basin.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally to direct water flow to different areas of the sink.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the central frame base of the faucet, made of stainless steel, supporting the spout.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the spout to the sink and internal water lines, ensuring stability and sealing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and provides a stable mount for the spout.
